# Draft:Nightmares as Extensions of the Waking State

Nightmares as Extensions of the Waking State is the 13th studio album by Swedish heavy metal band Katatonia, released June 6th, 2025 via Napalm Records.
Background
The album gets more experimental and more metal without holding back on catchiness . The dark hooks and tender vocals remain, yet the band also drive in unpredictable directions while delivering their hardest riffs in years. With sonic landscapes that evoke dystopia, inner demons, purity, and beauty alike, Nightmares as Extensions of the Waking State stands as a testament to their enduring brilliance. The album was produced by Jonas Renkse, recorded by Lawrence Mackrory at NBS Audio and The City of Glass, mixed by Adam Noble, and mastered by Robin Schmidt at 24-96 Mastering.
Crystal-clear production highlights the interplay between silence and intensity, while the contrast of heavy riffs, delicate guitar harmonies, ethereal synthesizers, and atmospheric nuances create captivating tension. Tracks like ‘Thrice’ and ‘Warden’ pulse with dynamic energy, a near-ceremonial piece, ‘Wind of No Change’, merges subtle electronic textures with Katatonia’s enigmatic soundscapes, while ‘Temporal’ balances fragility and strength - its intense verses culminating in a soaring, emotionally charged chorus. The breathtaking ‘Efter Solen’ (English for After the Sun), featuring Swedish lyrics, evokes echoes of Jonas Eika’s 2018 short story collection, with minimalistic yet striking instrumentation.
Release and promotion
The album and its release date were announced April 8th, 2025, for release via Napalm Records, with the first single ‘Lilac’ released upon the album announcement. The second single ‘Temporal’ was released May 7th with a third single, ‘Winds Of No Change’, released shortly before the album. An extensive UK and Europe Tour was scheduled for throughout November and December, followed by joining Opeth on ‘The Last Will and Testament’ North American Tour, part 2 as their special guests before embarking on their own headline tour of North America and Latin America. As a final single, the album’s Bonus track, a hauntingly beautiful rendition of the KISS (band) classic “A World Without Heroes” was released November 11th, 2025.
Reception
Nightmares as Extensions of the Waking State charted on 13 charts across 9 countries, including Sweden, Germany, the UK, the US and Canada. The album was also in Fistful of Metal's Top 10 albums of 2025, and earned a place in Metal Hammer's Top 50 albums of 2025.
